embed.author: rude1.blacksky.team
embed.text:
Every time you view or like a post or take most actions on Bluesky or Blacksky your requests go through your Personal Data Server (PDS). It’s also the home of all your data.

To date, we’ve used other people’s software to run Blacksky’s fleet of PDS.

In the next week we’ll be migrating to our own.
